name: Secret Agent - Mini Game 3-bon Pack
original_name: Secret Agent ミニゲーム３本パック
source:
- Kanon's Story -
One day, Kanon wants to visit the ninja village where Jin was born and raised, so they decide to go there for a holiday. They stay overnight in the village they visit and share the bed together.

- Kagura's Story -
Jin stays at the school and treats Kagura in contact as his girlfriend.
After they became lovers, Kagura continues to be a knight with Jin accompanies her to practice together. One day, they decide to use the arena to practice in armor.
They are training until late, alone in there.

- Mai's Story -
After the case is solved, Mai and Jin remain and continue to have a relationship as lovers.
One day, Jin is coming to Mai's room to see what's going on and he finds food on the dining table. Mai is nowhere to be seen. While he is wondering what to do, suddenly Mai appears from the bathroom in a naked apron...

[Translated from the [url=http://www.ensemble-game.com/sikueji_minigame3pack/]official website[/url]]
